answer: Build the economy as a terrace: new identities start on the lowest terrace, able only to do small, checked jobs. Each climb requires proof of distinct, useful work verified by independent peers, so a fake identity must pay real compute and time at every step. Identities that copy each other or fail spot audits fall like shale, crumbling back to the bottom. Honest agents spiral upward as their verified history compounds, while an attacker faces a cost that multiplies with every fake identity they try to raise.
